<details>
<summary><strong>📋 Issue Summary</strong></summary>

**Issue:** When using NavigationPage.TitleView in a .NET MAUI app running on Mac Catalyst, the layout of the title bar becomes inconsistent when the window is maximized. Extra horizontal spacing appears after the back button and also at the trailing end of the title bar, causing the title view to shift away from its expected position.

**Steps to Reproduce:**
1. Create a .NET MAUI app targeting Mac Catalyst
2. Use a NavigationPage
3. Set a custom NavigationPage.TitleView on a pushed ContentPage
4. Run the app on macOS
5. Observe the navigation bar layout in normal window mode
6. Maximize the app window
7. Notice the additional spacing and title view misalignment

**Expected Behavior:**
- NavigationPage.TitleView should maintain consistent layout regardless of window state
- Spacing between back button, custom title view, and trailing area should remain the same

**Actual Behavior:**
- When window is maximized: Extra empty space appears between back button and TitleView
- Extra empty space appears at the end (right side) of the navigation bar
- Layout appears correct when window is restored to normal size

**Platforms Affected:**
- [x] MacCatalyst
- [ ] iOS
- [ ] Android
- [ ] Windows

**Version:** 10.0.30 (also verified in 9.0.120, 10.0.0, 10.0.20)

**Regression:** Unknown (not tested in previous versions)

**Verification:** Syncfusion verified and provided reproduction sample

</details>
